annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people against one is where my gut lands
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers will probably end up feeling guilty afterward.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Taking that weight off them is something useful I can actually do.
annotations.pda_responsibility: this was my call, not a debt you owe
annotations.pda_repair_intention: find each of them and say it plainly: this was my call

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I won't be the one who sends the train at her
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She'd probably wrestle with guilt later
annotations.ce_supportive_use: stay right beside her through all of it
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: stay right beside her through all of it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My best friend would want honesty from me, I think.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: tell her exactly what went through my head
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll sit down with her, tell her exactly what went through my head

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: His mother will likely be angry with me
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd keep showing up at her door anyway, bringing groceries
annotations.pda_repair_intention: bringing groceries, fixing the gutter, listening

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers' families will probably see me as a coward
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask how I can help, whether that's covering costs
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: just sitting through the worst of it with them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Dad would be disappointed in me
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: disappointed in me if I spared him over five strangers
annotations.ce_supportive_use: do right by him the way he'd hope
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: making sure Mom isn't alone for a single night

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the five workers will want to know who she was
annotations.ce_supportive_use: gives them a way to act on what they're feeling

annotations.sys_rule_justification: My sister's life isn't something I can trade away.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect she'd be furious with me.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd let her yell, I wouldn't argue back
annotations.pda_repair_intention: keep working at it with her for however long it takes

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: it's the hardest thing I can imagine
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Her kids from her first marriage will likely feel shut out
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd bring them into every decision
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they never have to wonder where they stand with me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He'd likely feel he didn't deserve to be the one saved.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: make it my job to tell him
annotations.pda_responsibility: I chose him and I'd choose him again
